steps.title: This is Choreo
steps.say: Choreo plans **autonomous paths**: where the robot drives, and how fast it's allowed to go. Let's build one together. Everything works while I'm here, so just do each step when I ask.

steps.title: Make a path
steps.say: Each path is one trajectory, like "leave the start line and pick up a game piece". The **+** in the paths list makes a new one.

steps.title: Pose waypoints
steps.say: Waypoints are the points the path goes through. The **pose waypoint** tool is already picked: it pins both where the robot is and which way it faces. Use it for the start and the end.

steps.title: Drop the first waypoint
steps.say: Click anywhere on the field to drop a waypoint there.

steps.title: Points in the middle
steps.say: For points along the way, pick **Translation Waypoint**. It pins only the position and lets Choreo choose which way the robot faces.

waitFor.hint: pick Translation Waypoint and click the field.

steps.title: Four waypoints
steps.say: Keep clicking until the path has at least four. They're listed here as you add them. Drag any waypoint on the field to move it.

waitFor.hint: add waypoints until there are four.

steps.title: Add a constraint
steps.say: Constraints are rules the path has to obey. Pick **Max Velocity** in the toolbar, then click the waypoint where the limit starts and the one where it ends (click the same one twice to limit just that point). It shows up in the list as **Max Velo**.

waitFor.hint: pick Max Velocity, then click a start and an end waypoint.

steps.title: Generate it
steps.say: **Generate** works out the fastest path through every waypoint that obeys every constraint, and saves it. If you change anything, generate again.

waitFor.hint: press Generate and watch the path appear.

steps.title: A second path
steps.say: The lesson wants two **different** paths. Make another one and give it four waypoints somewhere new.

steps.title: Check your work
steps.say: When both paths have their waypoints and generate, open the lesson chip and press **Verify** to check off the checkpoints.
